drafted_from: tool:google-account-update_send_as_signature's own row in tools/read-and-write-gmail/tool-rows.json (invoke method, url, body_template, input and output schema); Gmail response values worked out from that row for the synthetic input
start_here: Say to your AI: "Set my signature on sam@example.com to "Sam, Sam's Bakery". Use my Google account connection service_connection:google-account:sam-bakery." It runs tool:google-account-update_send_as_signature as that account and hands back the Gmail answer.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it calls Gmail for one Google account the connection names and answers what Gmail returns.
instructions: 1. Connect a Google account in your Workshop connections and note its handle, like service_connection:google-account:sam-bakery.

2. Say to your AI: "Set my signature on sam@example.com to "Sam, Sam's Bakery"." and let it call run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:google-account-update_send_as_signature, and the input {"connection":{"connection_id":"service_connection:google-account:sam-bakery"},"send_as_email":"sam@example.com","signature":"
Sam, Sam's Bakery
"}.

3. Read what comes back: the request goes as PATCH the Gmail me-mailbox base (gmail.googleapis.com, v1)/settings/sendAs/sam@example.com with the body {"signature":"
Sam, Sam's Bakery
"}.
4. Read tool:google-account-list_send_as again afterwards to verify the saved value.

worked_examples.title: Set my primary Gmail signature on a sample input
worked_examples.ask: Set my signature on sam@example.com to "Sam, Sam's Bakery".
worked_examples.given:
read from tools/read-and-write-gmail/tool-rows.json (its invoke url, method and body_template) and checked against tools/read-and-write-gmail/test/rows.test.mjs. The primary send-as address sam@example.com (isPrimary true in list_send_as). The call it makes: PATCH the Gmail me-mailbox base (gmail.googleapis.com, v1)/settings/sendAs/sam@example.com with the body {"signature":"
Sam, Sam's Bakery
"}.
worked_examples.hands_back:
Gmail sanitizes the HTML and answers {"sendAsEmail":"sam@example.com","isPrimary":true,"signature":"
Sam, Sam's Bakery
"}.
